 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Not many chances to shout about in this one as Dan Burn launches himself at the deep ball into the box but it was way too much to ask. 
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:30 GMT 14:30 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Opta now says that Florian Wirtz's goal has been given to Brighton's Pascal Gross. It did take a hefty deflection off him. 
 71 186 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 That is a heck of a delivery from Rayan into the box and Evanilson throws himself at it but the ball just skims his head and he can't get any purchase or direction on it.
 55 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ruthless Liverpool published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 The clocks have changed and it's the first time that Liverpool have scored in the first half at Anfield in the Premier League this season.
 Better late than never. Liverpool have punished Brighton ruthlessly.
 413 78 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Incredible stuff from Ronald Araujo as he manages to head the ball clear while lying on the turf. 
 Brighton looked pretty likely to halve the deficit but some desperate Liverpool defending cleared the danger. 
 299 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 14:28 GMT 14:28 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Tyler Adams goes into the book for a foul in the middle of the park.
 90 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:28 GMT 14:28 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 I'm sure Michael Carrick would have loved to get through today without having to turn to Bruno Fernandes. A comfortable win without the Portuguese would have suited him just fine.
 But in reality, that seems unlikely.
 201 91 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:27 GMT 14:27 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Image source, Getty Images Bruno Fernandes is still Manchester United's best player so if you're not winning football matches and you look to the bench and you've got Fernandes there, then you have to bring him on. 
 169 403 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Really, really didn't expect a start like this from Liverpool...
 Aarav 
 All 100m+ men involved!
 Andrew 
 That second Liverpool goal was classic Klopp style, and is what we missed so much. Counter press, fast break.
 Jason 
 740 147 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Image source, Getty Images Harvey Barnes is looking lively but he opts to go for the early strike instead of going past Anan Khalaili and his effort is blocked. 
 63 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:25 GMT 14:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Alexander Isak has scored in three consecutive Premier League appearances for the first time since January 2025 for Newcastle (run of eight).
 577 122 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:25 GMT 14:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Brighton are struggling to deal with Liverpool here. It certainly isn't the Liverpool we've seen at Anfield in recent times. 
 704 110 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Hull 1-0 Brentford published at 14:25 GMT 14:25 GMT 
 Oliver McBurnie (24 mins, pen) 
 Image source, Getty Images Easy as you like.
 Oliver McBurnie slots right into the bottom corner, leaving a diving Caoimhín Kelleher with no chance of getting there.
 Hull have the lead.
 579 199 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Isak is cruising and so are Liverpool published at 14:24 GMT 14:24 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 It's brilliant from Liverpool. Bradley Barcola wins the ball and leaves Alexander Isak with the most simple of finishes for his sixth goal in his last six Premier League games. Isak is cruising and so are Liverpool. 
 1024 222 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:23 GMT 14:23 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Charlie Adam 
Former Liverpool midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live extra 
 That was just sheer strength from Barcola, he put Boscagli off the ball and then a lovely pass to Isak. 
 624 95 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY - HULL published at 14:22 GMT 14:22 GMT 
 Hull 0-0 Brentford 
 What are Brentford playing at here? They're messing around at the back and Caoimhin Kelleher plays his pass short to Aaron Hickey and Tim Iroegbunam is alert to it. Hickey brings him down while going for the ball.
 The referee points to the spot.
 429 217 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 2-0 Brighton published at 14:21 GMT 14:21 GMT 
 Alexander Isak (21 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images Liverpool are flying. 
 Alisson pings it long towards Bradley Barcola and he has a stroke of luck before picking out Alexander Isak , who finishes really well. 
 Anfield is bouncing!
 3058 729 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'That will do Wirtz the world of good to his confidence' published at 14:21 GMT 14:21 GMT 
 Liverpool 1-0 Brighton 
 Charlie Adam 
Former Liverpool midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live extra 
 That was good play from Liverpool. It was a ricochet, Brighton didn't deal with that good enough. 
 We talk about build ups and tactical details but ultimately it is a smash n the box. It is a good goal from Wirtz and that will do him a world to his confidence. 
 799 141 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:21 GMT 14:21 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Dwight McNeil has a confused look on his face and you can't blame him. He drives the ball into a great place in the box but Jean-Philippe Mateta was hanging back. 
 43 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:20 GMT 14:20 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Diogo Dalot has seen quite a bit of the ball so far and this time he dinks it on for Mason Mount but there's a real lack of quality on the ball into the box and that is what has been missing for Manchester United so far.
